dataset.name: QTE Technologies Industrial & Scientific Product Catalog
dataset.citation: Nguyen Huu, Tuan (2026), QTE Technologies Industrial & Scientific Product Catalog (1M+ Items) - Multilingual Dataset, Mendeley Data, V7, DOI: 10.17632/hr2ysn26ys.7
dataset.purpose: Curated hardware and MRO examples for the Goodstock demo catalog.
dataset.limitations: The source feed is an industrial/MRO catalog. Source price and availability fields are excluded because the CSV does not specify a currency and most records say preorder. PHP prices and inventory quantities below are illustrative demo values, not source facts or sale offers. Linked supplier images are not reused; category illustrations are generic and do not depict exact branded products. Verify product compatibility and specifications before any real sale.
